current_grouping: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
(a) Each wing flap control must be designed so that, when the flap has been placed in any position upon which compliance with the performance requirements of USAR is based, the flap will not move from that position unless the control is adjusted or is moved by the automatic operation of a flap load limiting device.
(b) The rate of movement of the flaps in response to the operation of the UAV crew’s control or flight control system must give satisfactory flight and performance characteristics under steady or changing conditions of airspeed, engine power or thrust and attitude.
